text: The current version of Pest, the elegant testing framework for PHP developers, is **v5.3.0**, which was published on Packagist.org on **October 1, 2026, at 18:09 UTC** [1]. While development continues under `5.x-dev`, **v5.3.0** represents the latest stable release [1]. The major version, Pest 5, became available on **July 28, 2026**, offering compatibility with PHP **8.4** and later [2][3][4].
